description: Known credential shapes, shared by chorus-core's scrubber and scripts/secret-grep.mjs, so the gate never tests different shapes than the scrubber redacts. Ported from Chorus 1 (src/main/services/secret-patterns.json). ORDER MATTERS: the specific sk- prefixes must precede the generic sk- pattern. Each pattern is a prefix of literal characters or one-character classes, then one character class with a length, so it can be matched without a regex engine; ordinary text (Windows paths, UUIDs, git SHAs) must survive unchanged.
